en.bilal-muhammad: Ali b. Ahmad b. `Abdullah al-Barqi (rh) narrated to us. He said: My father narratred to us from Ahmad b. Abi `Abdillah from Muhammad b. `Isa b. `Ubayd from Abi Muhammad al-Ansari from another person from Abi Ja`far al-Baqir (as). He said:
Whoever awakes and finds the coolness of our love upon his heart should praise Allah for the beginning of blessing.
It was said: What is the beginning of blessing? So, he said: A pure birth.
